digitalWitness.scope: All 16 encoded notation rows and terminal double bars readable in the query-bearing song route. Bare node/16053 omitted the song grid.
digitalWitness.viewingMethod: Web text extraction of encoded HTML; not rendered glyph or scan pixel inspection.

musicalForm.repeatConfidence: Readable text has only one [sthayi] label; SNLTR rows have group separators and final ll ll. No numeric repeat expansion established. Single written traversal is the ledger, not a certified performed repeat order.
musicalForm.sectionCaveat: Do not infer antara boundaries from the separate AI experiment or split the 16 lines into invented sections.
musicalForm.completeScope: Full written song through the final cadence and terminal bars in both accessible representations; printed full-form and canonical marks remain unverified.
musicalForm.projectionCaveat: Pitch is relative swara plus explicit octave offset. Matra timing is not seconds and is not asserted to equal a Western quarter note.

timingMethod.rule: Each cell is one matra; slash subdivisions share it equally. '-' extends only the immediately preceding main event; repeated pitch letters are separate attacks. Parenthesized kan remain annotations and receive no invented time.

independentComparison.method: Separate lexical decoder of the publicly readable SNLTR font-code rows, then cell-by-cell comparison with the corpus text. s/r/g/m/p/q/n map to S/R/G/M/P/D/N; h lower and f upper octave; a vowel encoding ignored; leading capital N/R kept as kan; dash retained as sustain. Adjacent swaras decode to equally divided units under the corpus's published text rules.
independentComparison.limitation: Independent literal encoding comparison, not an independent interpretation of the original typography. Both witnesses share SNLTR lineage. Equal timing depends on the published encoding rules; no MIDI bytes or canonical JSON read.
